full_name: Thrishantha Nanayakkara | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Thrishantha Nanayakkara’s current research interests are in legged locomotion of field robots that can learn, through interaction with humans and animals, to accomplish complex goals in an unstructured environment.
